userDirective.purpose: Tell canonical memory how to integrate NEW_INFORMATION_INTAKE #1 against the already-existing GWC matrices without creating a parallel matrix.

centralMatrix.coverage: 73/73 contracts have exactly one owning blueprint

integrationInstruction.primaryRule: Do not create a second generic contract matrix. Reuse the existing registries, matrices, workflow graph, blueprints, evolution designs and design sheets.
integrationInstruction.action: Confront NEW_INFORMATION_INTAKE #1 with the existing matrices and produce only missing columns/bindings/projections.
requiredMissingLayer: Macro Contract layer MC-A..MC-H as an additive orchestration projection
macroContractRef binding for each runtime GW contract
Master Construction Crosswalk consolidating already-existing distributed bindings
preserveExisting: existing graph, findings, decisions, evidence, attestation, replay and recovery semantics
forbiddenInterpretations: Do not replace canonical families A..I with MC-A..MC-H.
Do not renumber, delete, merge or recreate GW-01..GW-73.
Do not duplicate Contract Registry, Workflow Graph, Task Queue, Live State, Operational Memory, Session, Lock, GitRegistry or deployment authority.
Do not treat NEW_INFORMATION_INTAKE #1 as automatically adopted architecture without reconciliation.

executionBinding.GWC-PRE-B-01: Use reconciled intake #1/#2 plus 18 blueprints, 73 contracts, findings, decisions and existing code to derive the complete branch-local candidate implementation backlog.
executionBinding.GWC-PRE-B-02: Bind candidate work items to exact contracts, code integration slots, dependencies, collision domains, tests and evidence without introducing parallel authorities.
executionBinding.GWC-PRE-B-03: Audit the synthesized backlog/crosswalk for omissions, duplicates, orphan contracts, conflicting ownership, missing dependencies and unbound findings/decisions.

integrationInstruction.runtimeOrderVsBuildOrder: Keep runtime graph order separate from software build order; build order is dependency-derived.

reconciliation.note: When continuation is requested, #1 and #2 must be reconciled together before B-01 backlog synthesis.
